shocks.name: FX liquidity crisis
shocks.description: Local currency devalues about 55%; foreign downpayments wait for FX allocation.

shocks.name: Approval policy change
shocks.description: New delegation of authority: MD threshold raised from USD 5k to 25k and e-approvals.

shocks.name: Port congestion
shocks.description: Six weeks of congestion at the import port; foreign deliveries are held.

shocks.name: New marine contract
shocks.description: Two additional tug vessels under contract; Marine demand steps up about 25%.

shocks.name: Key supplier suspension
shocks.description: A top foreign marine supplier suspends shipments for eight weeks.

demand_drivers.CM: Corrective maintenance: negative binomial, rises with rainy season (peak mid-July) and fleet utilisation
demand_drivers.PM: Planned maintenance: fixed 4-week and 13-week schedule, parts requested 14-21 days ahead (known future covariate)
demand_drivers.RESTOCK: MRP run every second Tuesday, +30% in the October-November budget push
demand_drivers.PROJECT: Lumpy bursts of 12-40 lines in about 3% of weeks
